title: How Each Zodiac Sign Apologizes (Without Saying Sorry)

segments.text: No sign says sorry the same way. Here's how each one does it.

segments.title: ARIES
segments.text: Aries brings you a snack, and acts like nothing happened.

segments.title: TAURUS
segments.text: Taurus shows up with your favorite flowers.

segments.title: CANCER
segments.text: Cancer writes you a three page letter.

segments.title: VIRGO
segments.text: Virgo quietly fixes what they broke.

segments.title: SCORPIO
segments.text: Scorpio just holds your gaze. That's the apology.

segments.title: SAGITTARIUS
segments.text: Sagittarius makes you laugh until you forget.

segments.title: CAPRICORN
segments.text: Capricorn shows up on time, every day after.

segments.title: AQUARIUS
segments.text: Aquarius explains exactly why it happened.
Which one apologized to you? Comment your sign, and send this to them.
